deals.evidence: Governor Wes Moore today announced that the Board of Public Works has unanimously approved a long-term agreement between the Maryland Stadium Authority and the Baltimore Orioles
deals.headline: Orioles and Maryland agree 30-year Camden Yards lease
deals.investor: Maryland Stadium Authority / State of Maryland
deals.source_name: Office of the Governor of Maryland
deals.summary: Maryland's Board of Public Works approved a long-term agreement between the Maryland Stadium Authority and the Orioles keeping the team at Camden Yards for thirty years.

deals.evidence: was sold for $1.725 billion to Rubenstein, a Baltimore native and the co-founder/co-chairman of The Carlyle Group
deals.headline: Rubenstein group's $1.725bn purchase of the Orioles control stake approved
deals.summary: MLB owners unanimously approved the sale of the control stake (with the club's stake in MASN) from the Angelos family to a group led by David Rubenstein for $1.725 billion; agreement reached 31 January 2024. Rubenstein reportedly bought a 40% stake at that point.

deals.evidence: Prior to today, Rubenstein’s group owned 40% of the team after completing the majority purchase of the Orioles over the offseason, and now they have purchased the remaining 60%.
deals.headline: Rubenstein group buys remaining 60% of the Orioles
deals.summary: The Rubenstein group, which held 40% after the majority purchase, bought the remaining 60%, buying out the last minority ownership of the Angelos-led group.

stadium_owner.detail: Owned by the State of Maryland through the Maryland Stadium Authority; 30-year lease approved December 2023.

wages.source_name: Forbes (estimate) — player expenses incl. benefits and bonuses

founded_evidence: baseball's owners unanimously agreed upon the move of the St. Louis Browns to Baltimore
name: Baltimore Orioles
notes: Founded year is the franchise's move to Baltimore (owners approved 28 Sept 1953; first Orioles season 1954); the franchise itself dates to 1901 (Milwaukee Brewers / St. Louis Browns), not sourced on a citable page. Revenue, operating income and player expenses are Forbes estimates for 2025 (Forbes rank #17, price paid $1.73B in 2024). No individual partner percentages are published. Charm City Sports Partners is the vehicle of three Ares Management executives investing personally (not an Ares fund); Avenue Sports Fund and Brown Advisory are listed as owners on the club's own page with no stake or date. The Camden Yards lease value/public money is not stated on the governor's release. Attendance, socials, kit/shirt sponsor not sourced.

ownership_summary: Owned by the Baltimore Orioles Limited Partnership, controlled by Carlyle co-founder David Rubenstein. His group agreed to buy the control stake from the Angelos family for $1.725 billion (agreed January 2024, approved by MLB 27 March 2024, initially ~40%) and bought the remaining 60% on 1 August 2024. Partners include Charm City Sports Partners (Ares' Mike Arougheti, Mitch Goldstein, Michael Smith), Brown Advisory, Avenue Sports Fund, Cal Ripken Jr., Mike Bloomberg, Grant Hill and others.

stadium_owner.detail: Owned by the State of Maryland through the Maryland Stadium Authority; 30-year lease approved December 2023.
